The Ubiquiti UniFi U7-Pro is a high-performance WiFi 7 tri-band access point designed for modern enterprise and high-density wireless networks. It supports the latest 802.11be WiFi 7 technology, delivering ultra-fast wireless speeds and improved network efficiency across 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz bands.


The Ubiquiti UniFi U7 Pro WiFi 7 AP is a cutting-edge Ubiquiti Access Point engineered to deliver ultra-fast, reliable wireless connectivity in high-density environments such as offices, campuses, and enterprise networks. As a powerful Ubiquiti Tri Band Access Point, it supports the latest WiFi 7 (802.11be) standard and operates across the 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz bands, offering a combined data rate of up to 9335 Mbps. With six spatial streams and support for over 300 concurrent clients, this Ubiquiti AP ensures smooth performance even under heavy network loads. The device features a 2.5 GbE uplink port with PoE+ support, simplifying installation by delivering both power and data through a single cable. Designed for ceiling or wall mounting, it provides up to 140 square meters of coverage and operates reliably in temperatures ranging from -30°C to 40°C. The Ubiquiti UniFi U7 Pro Access Point also includes advanced features like band steering, fast roaming (802.11r), wireless meshing, and enterprise-grade security with WPA3, guest network isolation, and dynamic VLAN assignment. Managed through the UniFi Network application, it offers centralized control, remote monitoring, and seamless scalability. With its sleek design, robust performance, and future-ready technology, the UniFi U7 Pro is an ideal choice for organizations seeking a high-capacity, high-speed wireless solution that’s built to grow with their needs


Key Features


  • Latest WiFi 7 (802.11be) tri-band technology
  • 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz frequency bands
  • Up to 9.3Gbps total wireless throughput
  • 6 spatial streams (2×2 per band)
  • 2.5GbE RJ45 uplink port
  • PoE+ (802.3at) powered
  • Supports 300+ connected devices
  • Coverage up to 140 m²
  • UniFi Network centralized management
  • Advanced security with WPA3, VLAN, Guest Network
